fixture.captured_from: fmi-radar-nowcast /features items, trimmed to the fields the clutter test reads

ground_truth.label: PARTIAL - inferred, not operator-confirmed
ground_truth.basis: 110 of 274 cells moved faster than 5 m/s with median path_straightness 0.86, i.e. coherent advection. A cell whose NET displacement from first detection exceeds a few km cannot be a fixed ground target, whatever its instantaneous speed.
ground_truth.caveat: Individual cells are NOT operator-labelled. Assertions below are limited to what net displacement alone establishes; do not treat this file as a labelled set.

observed_behaviour_before_fix.note: 'clutter' led significance_reasons on these, demoting severe cells from a median rank of 20 to ranks 135-197.
